historical_catalog_entry.name: ionext

paper.title: IONext: Unlocking the Next Era of Inertial Odometry

repo.license: n/a (code promised after peer review; not released as of 2026-09-17)

input.channels: [acc, gyro] per paper wording (order irrelevant: full-channel stem conv)

pitfalls: No code; v1 (DADM/STGU) and v2 (ADM/AGU) disagree on gating axis and per-wing BN; card follows v2 (only v2 gating matches the reported 1.1e7 params).
Stem/downsample normalisation, head, AGU value-branch kernel and softmax axis are unspecified; card fills them with marked assumptions.
Paper re-splits all datasets randomly 8:1:1 and reports length-normalised metrics x100; not comparable with IPB.
historical_catalog_entry.notes: Spec model: stem Conv(6,96,k4,s4)+BN, stages [2,2,6,2] x [96,192,384,768] ADE blocks (4.5C^2+35C params each), BN+Conv(k2,s2) downsampling, BN+GAP+Linear head; 10,641,506 params (D=2) vs reported 1.1e7; 35.6M MACs at T=200 vs reported 7.3e7 FLOPs.
